## Original Model

```{r}
# Load required packages
library(rjags)

# Create model code
model_code <- textConnection("
model {
  for (i in 1:2) {
    r[i, 1:3] ~ dmulti(P[i, 1:3], n[i])
  }

  s <- G[1,2] / (G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3])

  # Transition probabilities at t = 2 years
  P[1,1] <- exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3]) * 2)
  P[1,2] <- s * exp(-G[2,3] * 2) * (1 - exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3]) * 2))
  P[1,3] <- 1 - P[1,1] - P[1,2]
  P[2,1] <- 0
  P[2,2] <- exp(-G[2,3] * 2)
  P[2,3] <- 1 - P[2,2]

  for (j in 2:3) {
    G[1,j] ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)
  }
  G[2,3] ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)

  # Transition probabilities at t = 0.25 years
  P3[1,1] <- exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3]) * 0.25)
  P3[1,2] <- s * exp(-G[2,3] * 0.25) * (1 - exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3]) * 0.25))
  P3[1,3] <- 1 - P3[1,1] - P3[1,2]
  P3[2,1] <- 0
  P3[2,2] <- exp(-G[2,3] * 0.25)
  P3[2,3] <- 1 - P3[2,2]
}
")

# Data
data_list <- list(
  r = matrix(c(20, 3, 7, 0, 5, 5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  n = c(30, 10)
)

# Initial values (one chain)
inits <- list(list(G = matrix(c(NA, 0.1, 0.1, NA, NA, 0.1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)))

# Parameters to monitor
parameters_to_save <- c("P", "P3", "s", "G")

# Run model
library(R2jags)
results <- jags(
  data = data_list,
  inits = inits,
  parameters.to.save = parameters_to_save,
  model.file = model_code,
  n.chains = 1,
  n.iter = 10000,
  n.burnin = 1000,
  n.thin = 10
)

# Check results
print(results)
```





### Second Model

```{r}
model_code <- textConnection("
model {
  for (i in 1:2) {
    r[i, 1:3] ~ dmulti(P[i, 1:3], n[i])
  }

  s <- G[1,2] / (G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3])

  # Transition probabilities at t = 2
  P[1,1] <- exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3]) * 2)
  P[1,2] <- s * exp(-G[2,3] * 2) * (1 - exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3]) * 2))
  P[1,3] <- 1 - P[1,1] - P[1,2]
  P[2,1] <- 0
  P[2,2] <- exp(-G[2,3] * 2)
  P[2,3] <- 1 - P[2,2]

  # Priors
  for (j in 2:3) {
    G[1,j] ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)
  }
  G[2,3] ~ dgamma(0.1, 0.1)

  # Transition probabilities at t = 0.25 (3 months)
  P3[1,1] <- exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3]) * 0.25)
  P3[1,2] <- s * exp(-G[2,3] * 0.25) * (1 - exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3]) * 0.25))
  P3[1,3] <- 1 - P3[1,1] - P3[1,2]
  P3[2,1] <- 0
  P3[2,2] <- exp(-G[2,3] * 0.25)
  P3[2,3] <- 1 - P3[2,2]
}
")
```

```{r}

data_list <- list(
  r = matrix(c(20, 3, 7, 0, 5, 5), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
  n = c(30, 10)
)

inits <- list(
  list(G = matrix(c(NA, 0.1, 0.1, NA, NA, 0.1), nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))
)

params <- c("P", "P3", "s", "G")


```


```{r}
set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility

results <- jags(
  data = data_list,
  inits = inits,
  parameters.to.save = params,
  model.file = model_code,
  n.chains = 1,
  n.iter = 10000,
  n.burnin = 1000,
  n.thin = 10
)
```

```{r}
# Extract MCMC samples
mcmc_df <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, as.mcmc(results)))

credible_intervals <- mcmc_df %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") %>%
  group_by(Parameter) %>%
  summarise(
    lower = quantile(Value, 0.025),
    median = quantile(Value, 0.5),
    upper = quantile(Value, 0.975)
  )

print(credible_intervals)


# Plot transition rates
mcmc_df %>%
  select(starts_with("G[")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Parameter", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_density(fill = "skyblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ Parameter, scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Distributions of Transition Rates")

# Plot transition probabilities
mcmc_df %>%
  select(matches("^P3?\\[")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Probability", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Value)) +
  geom_density(fill = "darkorange", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_wrap(~ Probability, scales = "free", ncol = 4) +
  labs(title = "Posterior Distributions of P and P3", x = "Probability", y = "Density")
```










### New Sim

```{r}
# Function to compute a single transition matrix at time t
compute_transition_matrix <- function(G, t) {
  s <- G[1,2] / (G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3])
  P <- matrix(0, nrow = 3, ncol = 3)
  
  # From State 1
  P[1,1] <- exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3]) * t)
  P[1,2] <- s * exp(-G[2,3] * t) * (1 - exp(-(G[1,2] + G[1,3] - G[2,3]) * t))
  P[1,3] <- 1 - P[1,1] - P[1,2]

  # From State 2
  P[2,1] <- 0
  P[2,2] <- exp(-G[2,3] * t)
  P[2,3] <- 1 - P[2,2]

  # From State 3 (absorbing)
  P[3,1] <- 0
  P[3,2] <- 0
  P[3,3] <- 1

  return(P)
}

# Simulate system evolution over time from a given starting state
simulate_system <- function(G_samples, start_state = c(1, 0, 0), steps = 8, dt = 0.25) {
  n_states <- length(start_state)
  simulations <- vector("list", nrow(G_samples))

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(G_samples))) {
    G <- matrix(NA, nrow = 2, ncol = 3)
    G[1,2] <- G_samples[i, "G[1,2]"]
    G[1,3] <- G_samples[i, "G[1,3]"]
    G[2,3] <- G_samples[i, "G[2,3]"]

    dist <- start_state
    trace <- matrix(NA, nrow = steps + 1, ncol = n_states)
    trace[1, ] <- dist

    for (s in 1:steps) {
      P <- compute_transition_matrix(G, dt)
      dist <- as.vector(dist %*% P)
      trace[s + 1, ] <- dist
    }
    simulations[[i]] <- trace
  }

  return(simulations)
}
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(abind)
library(ggplot2)

# Sample 500 posterior draws
G_draws_mat <- as.matrix(mcmc_df %>%
  select(`G[1,2]`, `G[1,3]`, `G[2,3]`) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 500))

# Run simulation
simulation_results <- simulate_system(G_draws_mat, start_state = c(1, 0, 0), steps = 8)

# Stack simulations into 3D array: [time x state x draw]
sim_array <- abind::abind(simulation_results, along = 3)

# Mean trajectory over all draws
mean_trajectory <- apply(sim_array, c(1, 2), mean)

# Prepare tidy data frame for plotting
df <- as.data.frame(mean_trajectory)
colnames(df) <- c("State1", "State2", "State3")
df$Time <- seq(0, 2, by = 0.25)

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("State"), names_to = "State", values_to = "Probability")

# Plot
ggplot(df_long, aes(x = Time, y = Probability, color = State)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Expected State Probabilities Over 2 Years",
       x = "Time (years)", y = "Probability") +
  theme_minimal()
```
